notes.title: Tails of War is out on Steam!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44777814/c26f53630337c5504a4b4d43570aee7bf8408402.png[/img]
For the past 8 months, the WolverineSoft Studio, a game development student organization at the University of Michigan, has been hard at work on our latest release, Tails of War, a turn-based online-multiplayer strategy game. Inspired by Wargroove and Advanced Wars, Tails of War is set in a whimsical world filled with Anthropomorphic Cats. Play as the leaders of one of the three factions - Grass, Tundra, and Desert - in a battle for strategic dominance.

Tails of War was released on itch.io on December 6th, 2023. Today, we'll be releasing an improved version of Tails of War on Steam. It's the same game of wits, whiskers, and strategy, just with a new coat of paint.

[h2]Changes From The Original Release[/h2]
[b]Giji[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44777814/1cc1be3750ff29648d0cf8c9a76235d7180a68b1.png[/img]
[i]Credit to Leo Jackson for the custom images of Giji[/i]
We felt that the tutorials needed more than just a distant voice in the background. That's why we brought in Giji - the mascot of the University of Michigan's Video Game Music Club. General Giji will teach you all the games mechanics in unique and interactive tutorial missions.

[b]Controller Support[/b]
Tails of War now has full controller support! Xbox and DualShock controllers are currently supported.

[b] Accessibility [/b]
Tails of War offers a new host of accessibility features, including:
[list]
[*] Open Dyslexic Integration
[*] Customizable Hotkeys
[*] Customizable Colors
[/list]

To learn more, view the in-depth post here: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2687500?emclan=103582791474299222&emgid=3981812773508827185]Tails of War Accessibility[/url]

[b] Steam Features [/b]
Tails of War offers several features unique to steam, including:
[list]
[*] Steam Overlay Integration
[*] The ability to invite your friends to game on Steam
[*] 25+ Steam Achievements 
[*] Steam Cloud Integration
[/list]

[b] Misc [/b]
[list]
[*] Added over 10 Codex Entries describing the rules of the game
[*] Added several new hints to the hints system
[*] Added the option to have a confirmation window when a turn ends
[*] Several bug fixes
[/list]

[h1]Tails of War Soundtrack is Out Now[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44777814/f882e82762e4531713ca111ef209cf06977a9979.png[/img]
In addition to releasing our game on Steam, we also decided to release a standalone version of the soundtrack on Steam! View the soundtrack here: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2768510/Tails_of_War_Soundtrack/]Tails of War Soundtrack[/url]

notes.title: Tails of War Accessibility Features
notes.content:
For the past 8 months, our team has poured their heart and souls into Tails of War. We juggle a lot of responsibilities, but our shared passion for game development helps us push to finish our game. At the heart of this shared passion lies a commitment to inclusivity, ensuring that every gamer, regardless of their abilities, can embark on our turn-based multiplayer tactics adventure. Today, we are thrilled to shed light on the profound value we place on accessibility in Tails of War.  We're inviting players from all walks of life to join this game of strategy, wits, and whiskers.

[h2]Open Dyslexic[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44777814/10eb39f442b3a44a2c5ca3826144e7ee491c70da.png[/img]
Our first priority for accessibility was the dyslexic community. Tails of War is among the most text-heavy games we have ever developed, and thus we wanted to remove the barrier to entry for players with dyslexia. So we built an option for players to change all the text in the game from its default font to Open Dyslexic. Open Dyslexic is a font specifically designed to be easier to read for those with dyslexia. By including Open Dyslexic as an option in our game, we hope that more people can enjoy our whimsical world without difficulty. Visit the [url=https://opendyslexic.org/]Open Dyslexic Website[/url]  to learn more about the font.

[h2]Controller Support[/h2]
Some gamers find certain games easier to play on a controller than a keyboard. Certain controllers are specifically designed to be more accessible to players with disabilities. Thus, pushing for accessibility meant providing full controller support for players. Every part of our game - every menu and interaction, can be done via controller in addition to keyboard and mouse. We hope that those who choose to play Tails of War with a controller find it an enjoyable experience.

[h2]Hotkeys[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44777814/0bc893b7fc61c50ca00d6310346adefcf4dde4f3.png[/img]
An important addition we made to the improve the controller experience in Tails of War is the Hotkeys system. Through the accessibility settings menu, players can set hotkeys for many unique in game actions. These include:
[list]
[*] Accessing the codex page for a specific unit/tile type
[*] Zooming the camera in and out
[*] Cycling between units/cities
[/list]
Hotkeys can be configured for both controller and keyboard. Hotkeys will enable players to make their experience more convenient, such as viewing a codex entry with a simple keypress or configuring the camera to avoid mouse scrolling entirely.

[h2]Color Picker[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44777814/71dbab7c23a5001600813be5c1988338f14ba4c0.png[/img]
Our final accessibility feature was to make the colors in our game configurable. For those who are colorblind, or wish for more distinct colors, our custom color picker enables players to set the games colors for 5 different categories. Players can set the path preview, unit outline, and unit healthbar colors to whatever they choose to create the experience that fits them best.

We look forward to seeing players use these features in our games, and we hope games find that these features enrich their gameplay experience.
